items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua officially active vs. Raiders despite calf injury; team optimistic after feeling better Saturday.
items.why: Calf; DNP Friday but no setbacks, sources say available.
items.implication: Full WR1 role expected in high-total game; start with confidence.
items.opportunity: Primary target share with Adams out; routes/red-zone intact.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall officially inactive; unlikely after limited practice returning from quad strain, may work out but not full participant.
items.why: Quad; missed 3 games, limited return, early in recovery.
items.implication: Sit; other Jets RBs elevated for volume vs MIA.
items.opportunity: Lead back role to backups; third-down/goal-line to handcuffs.

items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks for Monday Night vs. Cowboys.
items.implication: Eagles pass game thinned; elevated TE/ remaining WR usage Monday.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Goedert and secondary options; Saquon pass-game bump possible.

items.text: Lamar Jackson downgraded to OUT for Sunday vs. Bengals with high ankle sprain; Tyler Huntley to start again.
items.why: High ankle sprain; limited practice but ruled out Saturday.
items.implication: Huntley starts; Ravens offense downgraded, especially pass game and designed runs.
items.opportunity: Reduced dual-threat upside; monitor Huntley checkdowns to Andrews/Likely.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey went to locker room then returned during game.
items.implication: Monitor for limitation; 49ers WR outs already elevating his involvement.
items.opportunity: Potential more slot/WR snaps amid depleted WRs (Evans/Deebo out).

items.text: Broncos CB Pat Surtain II inactive (ankle); unlikely, good chance back next week.
items.implication: ARI pass game upgrade; softer secondary.
items.opportunity: Boost for Cardinals WRs (Harrison, Wilson) targets/completion.

items.text: Saquon Barkley expected to play (listed Q) for Eagles.
items.implication: Start if active; volume RB1 role vs DAL.
items.opportunity: Carries/red-zone/ dual threat intact; more if WRs out.

items.text: Josh Jacobs listed IN and activated/expected for Packers.
items.implication: RB volume returns but post-layoff rust possible; monitor snaps.

items.text: Texans activated WR Tank Dell to active roster; set to return Sunday first action in nearly two years.
items.implication: Potential target competition/share in HOU pass game; monitor snaps/routes.
items.opportunity: Slot/deep threat return; could eat into Collins/others.

items.text: Jonah Coleman should be rostered in 100% of leagues; by year end the Broncos RB you wish you had. IN/activated.
items.implication: Add/roster immediately; stash or flex potential.

items.text: Puka high in top-10 overall rankings heading into Sunday; confirmed active.
items.why: Faith in availability and talent despite limited practice.

items.text: Statuses of Lamar (ankle), Puka (calf), Breece (quad) crucial to Sunday DFS main slate; projections updated on latest news. Sneaky scratches: Egbuka, Brian Robinson, Tyler Warren, Jahwar Jordan.
items.why: Early news pending; missed scratches impact depth.
items.implication: Pivot lineups on finals; handcuff/backup elevation.
items.opportunity: Role expansion for backups on OUT players.

items.text: Tempted to buy CMC lining up more at slot/WR given 49ers dire WR situation (Evans/Deebo out) and Kaelon Black presence, despite rarely believing RB-as-WR hype.
items.why: Coach/player comments + WR injuries; rare exception to skepticism.
items.implication: DFS/flex upside boost via routes/targets beyond pure RB.
items.opportunity: Increased slot snaps, routes, targets in depleted room.
items.conflict: Historical low hit rate on such statements.

items.text: Giants RB Cam Skattebo expected to resume lead back role vs Texans; JJ McCarthy long leash. Posted 124 yards/1 TD.
Loves A.J. Brown usage/matchup (WR10 range) in Week 7.
items.why: Usage and favorable matchup vs CHI-like spots; Bears soft vs pass.

items.text: Loves Tucker Kraft (TE buffet vs DET); Lions allow high TE production.
items.why: DET TE defense gift; multiple TEs hitting big numbers.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze (shadowed by Gonzalez; most targets outside, low floor).
items.why: 90% outside targets vs elite CB shadow; limited big games.
items.implication: Sit/fade in tough matchup vs NE.

items.text: Hates Josh Jacobs post-layoff (workload questions) vs DET.
items.implication: Cautious start despite IN; lower rank.
